candidates.description: The percentage of tumor cells expressing PD-L1 as determined by immunohistochemistry, used to predict response to immunotherapy.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric percentage associated with PD-L1 IHC staining or Tumor Proportion Score (TPS).
candidates.measurement_definition: Tumor Proportion Score (TPS) expressed as a numeric percentage (%).
candidates.name: PD-L1 Expression (TPS)
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain if a consistent antibody clone (e.g., 22C3) was used for all measurements.

citations.quote: This aligns with the STK11 loss phenotype

candidates.description: The presence or absence of STK11 loss in the tumor molecular profile.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify the presence of 'STK11 loss' within the genomic or molecular profiling section.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if 'STK11 loss' is explicitly documented; negative if documented as wild-type or explicitly without loss. Absence of mention is not a negative result.
candidates.name: STK11 Status
candidates.uncertainty: The specific method used to determine 'loss' (e.g., copy number variation versus biallelic mutation) is not specified.

limitations: Small number of patient records provided for evidence discovery.
Limited detail on the specific laboratory assays used to define STK11 loss.
summary: The evidence identifies PD-L1 expression (TPS) and STK11 status as baseline molecular characteristics in patients with non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC), with STK11 loss specifically associated with resistance to single-agent checkpoint inhibitors.
